title: Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA
abstract: arXiv:2611.32782v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer. Yet mechanistic work suggests layers at different depths do qualitatively different work, raising a natural question: are their capacity demands also non-uniform, and if so, can a fixed parameter budget be allocated more wisely than uniformly? To probe this, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the input of each FFN down-projection and measure, for every layer, its intrinsic dimensionality as the smallest number of principal components needed to reconstruct the activation up to a fixed cosine similarity. Scanning 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families and 70M to 72B parameters, we find a recurring middle-heavy profile in which middle layers carry higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers; the profile is robust to the calibration corpus, even acr

translated_title: 通过PCA测量大语言模型中FFN的逐层内在维度
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）在每一层都保持前馈网络（FFN）中间宽度相同，这是从原始Transformer继承而来的惯例。然而，机制研究表明不同深度的层做着质上不同的工作，这引出了一个自然的问题：它们的容量需求是否也是不均匀的？如果是，固定的参数预算能否比均匀分配得到更明智的利用？为探究这一问题，我们对每个FFN下投影的输入应用主成分分析（PCA），并以将激活重构至固定余弦相似度所需的最少主成分数量来度量每一层的内在维度。通过扫描涵盖14个模型家族、参数规模从70M到72B的58个开源权重LLM，我们发现了一种反复出现的“中间重”轮廓——中间层的内在维度高于边缘层；该轮廓对校准语料库具有鲁棒性，甚至在不同……（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究用PCA测量58个开源LLM各层FFN的内在维度，发现中间层的内在维度显著高于边缘层的“中间重”分布，表明逐层均匀分配参数的传统设计并非最优，为非均匀的参数预算分配提供了实证依据。
en_tdlr: By applying PCA to measure layer-wise intrinsic dimensionality of FFN inputs across 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families, this paper reveals a robust "middle-heavy" profile in which middle layers require higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers, suggesting that uniform parameter allocation across layers is suboptimal.
